transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I'm feeling incredibly anxious and distressed about how my face looks, especially my nose. It is completely crooked and asymmetrical, and I feel like it makes me look absolutely hideous. I just can't stop worrying about how awful it is.
When you discuss this with family or friends, do they agree that your nose looks crooked, or do they tell you they don't see what you are seeing?

Whenever I ask my family or friends, they always tell me my nose looks completely normal and that they don't see any crookedness at all. I constantly ask them for reassurance, but their replies are just frustrating to me because I am convinced the flaw is completely obvious.

Yes, it really is incredibly overwhelming and exhausting to deal with every day. I'm not even sure how to fully describe the scope of my anxiety, other than that it completely takes over my thoughts.
Because of these concerns about your nose, do you find yourself spending a lot of time checking it in mirrors, trying to hide it, or comparing your appearance to others?

Yes, absolutely—I constantly check my nose in every window or reflective surface I pass, and I try to hide it by wearing sunglasses or tilting my head away from people. I also find myself constantly comparing my nose to everyone I see on the street, and I always feel like mine is so much worse and uglier than theirs.
Outside of your concerns about your appearance, do you find yourself constantly worrying about other everyday matters, like your health, work, or family?
No, I don't really worry about other everyday things like my health, work, or family. My anxiety and focus are almost entirely consumed by my appearance and how my nose looks.
Do you feel like people on the street or at work are actively staring at you, talking about you, or mocking you because of your nose?

Yes, I constantly feel like people on the street and at work are staring right at my nose and judging its shape. I'm not completely sure if they are actively mocking or laughing at me, but it really feels like they are focusing on how ugly it is. It makes me feel incredibly self-conscious whenever I am around others.
Do you think there is any possibility that your nose actually looks normal and your mind is playing tricks on you, or are you 100% certain that it is deformed?

I am almost completely certain that my nose is deformed and looks highly abnormal to me. Even though other people say it looks fine, I find it really hard to believe them because the crookedness is so obvious when I look at it. I just don't see how it could possibly be normal.
Have you ever sought out or undergone any medical procedures, like plastic surgery or other treatments, to try to fix your nose?

Yes, I have repeatedly sought out consultations with plastic surgeons and spent countless hours researching rhinoplasty to fix my crooked nose. I am desperate to get a cosmetic procedure to correct it, even though the doctors I've seen tell me it looks normal and hesitate to operate.
I can hear how exhausting and stressful this has been for you. How have these worries and the time spent on them impacted your daily routine, your work, or your ability to enjoy your hobbies?

I'm not entirely sure how to measure the exact impact on my work or hobbies, but these thoughts and behaviors definitely take up a massive amount of my time and energy every day. It feels like my mind is constantly occupied by this, which makes it really hard to focus on anything else.
How long have you been experiencing these intense worries about your nose? Did this start recently, or has it been going on for several months or years?
I'm not entirely sure of the exact timeline or when it first started. However, it feels like it has been a significant issue for quite some time now, definitely for several years.
